title: Hearty Croatian Mascarpone Pilaf
description: A salty and creamy Croatian dish featuring mascarpone, perfect for a weeknight dinner, served in a traditional Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Heat the chicken broth in a separate pot and keep warm.
In a large Korean brass bowl, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add the diced bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the Arborio rice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the warmed chicken broth, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each portion to absorb before adding the next.
Stir in the softened mascarpone cheese, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Using a syringe, drop small amounts of the mascarpone mixture into a bath of water with sodium alginate to create spheres.
Serve the pilaf in the Korean brass bowl, topped with the mascarpone spheres.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
